auth.staff_sign_in_lead: Sign in to the GEC workspace.
auth.student_sign_in_lead: Sign in to follow your study-abroad journey.
auth.forgot_lead: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
auth.forgot_sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for 60 minutes.
auth.password_rule: At least 10 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.reset_done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.
auth.new_password_lead: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one to continue.
auth.reset_mail_body: We received a request to reset your password. The link below is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this e-mail.

sso.connected_lead: Connect a Google or Microsoft account to sign in with it instead of your password.
sso.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect this account? You will no longer be able to sign in with it.
sso.no_password: Your account has no password yet. To set one, use “Forgot password” on the sign-in page.
sso.rules: How accounts are matched: an account connected before always signs in its owner. Otherwise the e-mail address is used only when the provider confirms it (Google: verified address; Microsoft: verified domain or your own single directory). New accounts are created only for students — staff accounts are created by administrators and can then sign in with Google or Microsoft.
sso.setup_google: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → Create OAuth client ID (Web application). Add the redirect address below as an authorised redirect URI.
sso.setup_microsoft: Microsoft Entra admin center → App registrations → New registration (Web). Add the redirect address below, then create a client secret under Certificates & secrets.
sso.tenant_hint: common = any Microsoft account; organizations = work / school accounts; or your tenant ID / domain to allow only your organisation (recommended for staff).
